commitments.description: 100% recyclable, reusable, or compostable primary packaging by 2025.

controversies.description: Mentos and Chupa Chups wrappers consistently appear in European beach-litter audits.

wooby.headline: Mentos and Chupa Chups wrappers — Wooby finds them on European beaches.
wooby.narrative: Perfetti Van Melle makes Mentos and Chupa Chups lollipops. Each lollipop has a tiny plastic wrapper that's hard to recycle. Wooby asks: please use a bin or take it home.
